verdict.rationale: Users can operate CDP in natural language through an AI assistant. The CDP CLI ships an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool, and Coinbase Wallet MCP lets any AI check balances, send funds, swap tokens and pay with x402. Agentic Wallet CLI skills also trigger on plain-language intents such as "send money", "fund", "trade" or "monetize an API". missing for 10: a first-party built-in natural-language interface (it relies on an external AI client), coverage of the custodial payment flows such as checkout, fiat payouts and deposit destinations specifically via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
